parameters.name: BizName
parameters.description:
The business scenario for record acceleration. Used as a filter condition for queries. Valid values:
- **image_video**: Image and video.
- **api**: API.
- **web**: Web page.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for paginated queries. The value must be greater than or equal to 1. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paginated queries. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: **500**.

parameters.name: Proxied
parameters.description:
Specifies whether proxy acceleration is enabled for the record. Used as a filter condition for queries. Valid values:

- **true**: Proxy enabled.
- **false**: Proxy acceleration disabled.

parameters.name: RecordMatchType
parameters.description:
The search matching mode for record names. Defaults to exact match. Valid values:

- **prefix**: Prefix match.
- **suffix**: Suffix match.
- **exact**: Exact match.
- **fuzzy**: Fuzzy match.

parameters.name: RecordName
parameters.description: Record name. Used as a filter condition for queries.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: Site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) API.

parameters.name: SourceType
parameters.description:
The origin type of the record. Used as a filter condition for queries (only CNAME records can be filtered by this field). Valid values:
- **OSS**: OSS origin.
- **S3**: S3 origin.
- **LB**: Load balancer origin.
- **OP**: Origin pool.
- **Domain**: Standard domain origin.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The DNS record type of the record. Used as a filter condition for queries.
